title: Explain how to make the best currentRefinedValue output
body:
For now the currentRefinedValues widget only displays the values of the current active refinements. When used in conjunction with the toggleWidget or the priceRanges one for instance, the output is not usable as it is. And I haven't found any option to also retrieve the facet name / label in addition to the value.

![image](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/1101220/23415977/51a9d8b4-fde1-11e6-9a0b-df4aa64bcb10.png)

comments.body: I've found a way to do it using the templates
How did you fix it (for posterity)
@seafoox Could a better name for this issue be: "display the attribute name along the value by default"?
I think we can write a guide about that because each page is different and would need custom tailored solutions.
We now show key & value in the current refinement widget, so the default display looks good.
